results.title: An in-flight key held past the stale window
results.evidence: a caller who abandons a request every 15 minutes keeps the key alive indefinitely: eleven abandonments later it is 0.00 hours old by `started_at` and the 24-hour sweep does not reach it. The stale release writes `started_at = now`, and the sweep reads `started_at` — so the column that means *when this attempt began* is also the column that means *how long we have kept this record*, and refreshing
